grades.quote: If the SUM bit in the `sstatus` register is set, supervisor mode software may also access pages with U=1. However, supervisor code normally operates with the SUM bit clear, in which case, supervisor code will fault on accesses to user-mode pages. Irrespective of SUM, the supervisor may not execute code on pages with U=1.
grades.reason: The U-bit paragraph directly explains how SUM affects supervisor access to U=1 pages. With SUM set, supervisor software can access them. With SUM clear, it faults. Supervisor code cannot execute from U=1 pages regardless of SUM.
